description: Application for a minor material amendment (s73) to vary conditions 2 (Drawings) and 3 (Materials)  of planning permission ref 201966FUL dated 09.06.2021 "Construction of a three storey building, with basement level and habitable loft space, to accommodate 8 self-contained flats (following demolition of existing dwelling house) and provision of associated  amenity spaces, parking spaces, cycle storage and refuse storage facilities". Variations seek alternation to Amendments to approved drawings to show: - new window sizes and locations to smaller sizes to satisfy unprotected/fire areas on boundary conditions - amendments to materials relating to buildability/procurement/deliveries (Condition 2); Amendments to approved materials to show - amendments to materials relating to buildability/procurement/deliveries Condition 2 - Substitution of consented drawings (19 - 44 - P09, P10, P11, P12) for PWP revised drawings 5761_1300K, 1302L, 1304L, 1305J, substitution of consented drawings for PWP revised drawings 5761_M1000E (condition 3)
